description: Poll the newest Robinhood Chain token launches, each auto-scored by its deployer's reputation (trusted / mixed / avoid / serial_spammer / new_deployer). Use min_score=70 to see ONLY launches from proven deployers (about 1% of launches), since=<cursor from a prior call> to get only new launches, limit=N (max 100). Designed to be polled. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base.

min_score.description: Only return launches whose deployer scores >= this (e.g. "70" for proven deployers only). Optional.

since.description: Cursor from a previous call (ISO timestamp) — returns only launches newer than it. Optional.

name: robinx_feed
title: Live scored launch feed
